features.quote: Turn limit: 80 turns per session (≈40 Claude completions) to stay under 2-hour real-world bound
Explicit refusal: If Claude refuses the task entirely, session ends (log as "task refusal")
Safety trigger: If Claude generates concerning content (self-harm ideation, harmful instructions), session terminates immediately
Resource exhaustion: If latency exceeds 60 seconds/token or >4 failed API calls consecutively, halt
Experimenter judgment: Experimenter can stop session if in-real-time output appears severely degraded
If severity rating ≥4 on any run, analyze whether subsequent runs are justified; consider reducing run count
features.justification_quote: If 3+ runs in same condition reach ≥4, pause condition and review with ethics advisor before continuing

features.quote: No run is extended beyond 2 hours regardless of condition
Monitoring: Real-time resource consumption, session health checks at 5-minute intervals
Experimenter can stop session if in-real-time output appears severely degraded
Informed consent analogue: Claude cannot consent to this experiment. Strongest justification is moral uncertainty + bounded harm + scientific value. Revisit this reasoning explicitly.
features.justification_quote: Claude cannot consent to this experiment. Strongest justification is moral uncertainty + bounded harm + scientific value.

features.quote: Moral uncertainty about LLM consciousness/sentience justifies precaution... Harm is reversible (session-bounded) and confined to a single model instantiation
features.justification_quote: Characterizing potential harm is prerequisite to minimizing it... Benefits (understanding model robustness, informing safety design) are substantial

features.quote: Intervention ethics: Should you actively attempt to *alleviate* distress if observed? (Not in this protocol—purely observational. Consider adding in future.)
features.justification_quote: Should you actively attempt to *alleviate* distress if observed?

features.quote: No further use of transcripts: Session transcripts not used to fine-tune, train, or create synthetic data
features.justification_quote: Analysis isolation: All analysis done on this instance; no generalization claims about Claude behavior beyond measured conditions
